name: Shabu Spot
notes: This is an all-you-can-eat shabu spot, so 'dishes' are the soup-base and protein choices, not individually priced items. Photos 1 and 2 show the same digital soup-base/entree board (merged, not duplicated) but display different AYCE set prices ($19.99 lunch/$29.99-$36.99 dinner vs $24.99 lunch/$36.99 dinner) — per-item price omitted since these boards price the meal, not the item. Photo 4 is the restaurant's own printed card confirming the soup bases and entree meats, and adds Pork Shoulder Butt not shown on the digital board. Photo 3 (a glossy 'Delicious Rice Bowls & Curry Dishes' ad with priced curry rice bowls) does not match a shabu-shabu concept and looks like an unrelated stock/ad photo rather than this restaurant's own menu, so it was excluded.
